info.name: Sockless Mail
info.summary: Webmail client for Nextcloud with multiple IMAP/SMTP accounts per user
info.description:
Sockless Mail is a webmail client for Nextcloud. Each user can connect any number of IMAP/SMTP accounts, with a password or by signing in with Google or Microsoft.
- **Mail**: unified inbox and folders across accounts, conversations, search, push for new mail, tags, rules, send later, and rich text with inline images - **Nextcloud**: attach from and save to Files, address book suggestions from Contacts, invitations in Calendar, tasks in Tasks, and Assistant summaries, translations and writing help - **Security**: sanitized HTML in a sandbox, remote images only on request, look-alike and new sender domains flagged, deceptive links marked, OpenPGP and S/MIME
It runs as an External App (AppAPI), so it needs a deploy daemon, preferably HaRP. Before installing, open **Advanced deploy options** and set `SOCKLESS_MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` to a long random value (at least 32 characters, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 48`), and keep a copy of it: it protects the stored mail passwords and can only be set during installation.
For the address `/apps/socklessmail/` and installing the page as a browser app, also install the companion app (id `socklessmail`).
info.author: Jimmy Everling

variable.name: SOCKLESS_MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variable.description: Protects the key ring that encrypts stored mail account passwords. At least 32 characters. Keep it outside backups of the app's data volume. See the README, "Security model".

variable.name: SOCKLESS_MAIL_ALLOW_LOCAL_SERVERS
variable.display-name: Allow mail servers on local networks
variable.description: "true" lets users connect to mail servers on private, loopback or carrier-grade NAT addresses (for an internal mail server). Off by default, so users cannot probe the network the app runs in.

variable.name: SOCKLESS_MAIL_BIMI_AUTHSERV_IDS
variable.description: Comma-separated host names (authserv-ids) whose Authentication-Results headers decide whether a message may show its sender's logo, e.g. "mx.example.com". Unset: the topmost header counts. Set it if your mail server does not add Authentication-Results itself. See the README, "Sender logos (BIMI)".
